features: [Premium Performance, Anywhere] Project up to a stunning 100-inch screen with 200 ANSI lumens brightness, Native 1080p Full HD resolution, and HDR10 support. Designed for immersive viewing in bedrooms, living rooms, and cozy movie spaces, Arc 5 delivers crisp visuals, balanced contrast, and punchy blacks. Perfect for sports nights, movie marathons, and late-night streaming.

[STR8 Smart Setup] Get the perfect picture instantly with STR8 (Auto Keystone ±30°), Auto Focus, and Obstacle Avoidance. The projector intelligently adjusts to your environment so you get a perfectly aligned image with minimal effort. 4-point manual keystone adjustment gives you extra control when you want precise positioning.

[Certified Streaming Experience] Powered by Official Android 14 Google TV with built-in Netflix, giving you access to 10,000+ apps including YouTube, Prime Video, JioHotstar and more. Enjoy voice search with Google Assistant, Google Cast, personalized recommendations, and Google Photos directly on the big screen.

[ArcLight Engine] Powered by Lumio’s sealed ArcLight optical engine, engineered to prevent dust ingress and maintain long-term picture clarity. The fully enclosed design preserves brightness and image quality over time, ensuring reliable performance and a longer projector lifespan.

[Sound You Can Feel] Built-in speakers with a tuned passive radiator and Dolby Audio deliver rich and room-filling sound. Use Arc 5 as a Smart Bluetooth Speaker, or cast music directly using Google Cast for a powerful audio experience even when the screen is off.

[Full Connectivity Suite] Connect all your devices seamlessly with HDMI 2.0 (ARC), 4K downscaling via HDMI, USB 2.0, Bluetooth 5.1, Dual Band Wi-Fi (2.4GHz + 5GHz), IR support, and HDCP 1.4 / 2.3 compatibility. Perfect for pairing with gaming consoles, streaming sticks, laptops, sound systems, and more.

[Warranty & Support] Enjoy 1 year comprehensive Lumio brand warranty covering the projector and remote control from the date of purchase. The warranty is supported by nationwide service coverage, with simple and free warranty registration.

[TLDR App] Arc 5 comes with TLDR, Lumio’s unique discovery experience built for fans of sports and music. Instantly find live matches, match highlights, trending performances, and curated music content in one place.

[Minion Noir Remote] Control everything effortlessly with the Minion Noir Remote, designed for quick navigation and entertainment control. Dedicated buttons for Netflix, YouTube, and Google Assistant voice control make it easy to jump straight into your favourite content.
[Neo on TLDR] Your new content discovery AI agent. Use Instagram / Whatsapp to play movies & shows on your Lumio Arc.
